title: Simplify Path

contractDetails.constraints: 1–3000 characters drawn from English letters, digits, periods, slashes, and underscores. Input is a valid absolute path.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned str.

statement: Normalize an absolute Unix path. Repeated slashes separate the same components. Ignore . components. A .. component removes the preceding ordinary component when one exists. Treat all other names, including ..., literally. Return a single leading slash, one slash between retained names, and no trailing slash unless the result is root.

examples.explanation: Parent steps cannot move above root.

constraints: 1–3000 characters drawn from English letters, digits, periods, slashes, and underscores. Input is a valid absolute path.
hints: Conceptual: Path components carry meaning as whole names.
Directional: Track the directory components that remain after each step.
Implementation: Split at slashes, skip empty or dot components, pop for dot-dot, and append every other name.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
